name: Priority
default: All priorities; selecting a level includes it and higher-priority levels.
basis: explanatory value in a general survey

levels.1: A foundational transition or central anchor in a short general history of nature and human societies.
levels.2: A major development, influential figure or durable institution with broad explanatory value across a region, era or discipline.
levels.3: A significant national, regional or subject-history entry that adds context beyond the central survey anchors.
levels.4: A focused episode, regional phase or specialist contribution most useful in a more detailed history.
levels.5: A narrow cultural or biographical detail, disputed imported claim or speculative scenario outside the main historical narrative.

limitations: Provisional editorial judgments; coverage and cultural familiarity affect prominence. Not moral worth, factual certainty, source quality or measured popularity.
